messages.text:
Create projects/cassette.md — the master plan for projects/cassette.html — following the house planning-doc standard. Requisite sections, in order: (0) TURN/STAGE LEDGER: a table of turns/stages with status, where every future build session appends a row before touching code; (1) RELEASES: numbered release list with one-line goals; (1b) OPEN QUESTIONS: a numbered list of the things still undecided, each followed by "Recommendation:" and your sensible default answer; (2) per-release sections: scope (in/out), build gates (how we verify, on real devices), and backlog of deferred items; (3) FUTURE IDEAS: unscheduled parking lot; (4) IMMUTABLE WORKING RULES: mobile-first, all diagnostics in-app (never DevTools), update-plan-before-code, read-back verification after every push, no stubs or fake data; (5) DECISION LOG: dated owner decisions; (6) APPENDIX: authority order (this plan is the sole authority; chat history loses to the plan). Seed it with what is known so far about projects/cassette.html (use the owner's own words) and mark everything else TBD. Keep it tight and scannable on a phone. In your reply, SUMMARY must be two or three plain sentences saying what you understood the project to be and how many open questions remain; and CHIPS must be exactly: Build it now with your recommendations | build it | (prompt) ;; Answer your questions first | questions | (prompt) ;; More ideas | more ideas | (prompt) — when there are no open questions use Build it | build it | (prompt) ;; Change the plan | change | (prompt) ;; More ideas | more ideas | (prompt).

THE OWNER'S ANSWER (freeform, in their own words — treat it as the project's goals, objectives, look and feel, considerations and open questions):
I want the phone screen to look like a cassete tape that is playing that has floating  controls that are old school buttons that have a analog travel and click as well as the ability to recorrd and playaback you can pulldown your library (opensource for now or spotiy of local) and play a song with pause, stop reviind and fast forward

I understand this as a mobile-first cassette-tape music player: the phone looks like a playing tape, with chunky old-school transport buttons that physically travel/click, pull-down library choices, and real record/playback. Six open questions remain; everything not stated by the owner is marked TBD.
